sloka: ततस्तेष्ववसन्नेषु सेनापतिषु पञ्चसु ।बलं तदवशेषं च नाशयास वानरः ।। ५.४६.३६।।।।
transliteration: tatasteṣvavasanneṣu senāpatiṣu pañcasu ।balaṁ tadavaśeṣaṁ ca nāśayāsa vānaraḥ ।। 5.46.36।।।।

translations.english: When the five army chiefs were killed, Hanuman began to destoy the remaining army force.
